purpose: Graded formal-verification vocabulary recorded as evidence metadata. Level is never scientific acceptance, CONTROLLING promotion, or lemma closure.
rule: verification_level ≠ acceptance. A node at L5 remains non-controlling until the owning Math- / claims authorities independently allow promotion under #90/#86 rules.

L0.label: prose_or_llm_argument
L0.description: Prose or LLM-produced argument without executable checks.

L2.label: exact_arithmetic_or_symbolic_cas
L2.description: Exact arithmetic or symbolic CAS checks.

L4.label: smt_or_decision_procedure_certificate
L4.description: SMT or decision-procedure certificate where applicable.

L5.label: proof_assistant_checked
L5.description: Proof-assistant checked theorem (Lean / Isabelle / Coq or selected equivalent).
